name: @monopos/prisma7-tools
description: Isolated Prisma 7 CLI. The deploy platform requires effect@4.0.0-rc.115 as the only effect version in the workspace tree, but the v7 CLI's config loader (@prisma/config@7.10.0) needs effect@3.20.0. This directory is intentionally NOT an npm workspace so the v7 CLI gets its own dependency tree. Install locally with: npm install --prefix tools/prisma7
